clients.name: Claude.ai / Claude Desktop (custom connectors)

config.snippet: Connector URL: https://YOUR-SERVER/mcp; authenticate with OAuth (paste YOUR_POLARION_PAT at Polarion login)

quirks: Remote connectors are added in Settings > Connectors; Claude Desktop remote servers are not configured in claude_desktop_config.json.
OAuth accepts DCR; custom client ID/secret can be supplied when DCR is unavailable.
SSE is supported but may be deprecated.

clients.name: Claude Code
quirks: Remote HTTP can be added with `claude mcp add --transport http polarion https://YOUR-SERVER/mcp`; callback URI is not published in the cited setup reference.

clients.name: Claude API MCP connector

config.snippet: Messages API MCP server URL: https://YOUR-SERVER/mcp; pass Authorization: Bearer YOUR_POLARION_PAT in request headers

quirks: API connector's OAuth registration and callback behavior are not asserted here; use documented API authentication parameters.

clients.name: ChatGPT connectors / Apps

redirectUris.uri: ChatGPT provides callback URI in the app setup/authorization metadata; fixed URI not verified

config.snippet: Create a custom MCP app with server URL https://YOUR-SERVER/mcp; select OAuth and configure the server authorization metadata.

quirks: ChatGPT custom MCP apps are remote only; OAuth requires refresh-token support for durable access.
Static API key auth is not a supported custom MCP authentication option in current docs.

clients.name: Custom GPT (Actions)

redirectUris.uri: Platform-specific Custom GPT callback URI not established from official docs
redirectUris.notes: OAuth is configured with client ID/secret; inspect the GPT editor for the exact callback before registration.

config.snippet: Action OpenAPI URL: https://YOUR-SERVER/openapi-gpt.json; configure API key auth with the deployment's HTTP_API_KEY. For GPT OAuth, use the MCP HTTP server's GPT Actions endpoints instead.

quirks: Custom GPT Actions use REST/OpenAPI rather than MCP transport; project publishes a reduced 30-action document.

clients.name: OpenAI Responses API / Agents SDK
quirks: The API caller supplies OAuth access token in authorization on each response request; no client-side callback URI is part of this API flow.
Accepts Streamable HTTP and HTTP/SSE.

clients.name: Codex CLI

config.snippet: codex mcp add polarion -- npx -y polarion-mcp (set API_BASE_URL and BEARER_TOKEN in the process environment)

quirks: CLI configuration is shared with the Codex IDE extension; `codex mcp add` is documented.

clients.name: VS Code Copilot
quirks: Maximum 128 tools per chat request; virtual tools can exceed this limit.
VS Code config uses top-level `servers`; portable Copilot config uses `mcpServers`.

clients.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio

redirectUris.uri: Generated by Copilot Studio tool setup; paste exact generated callback into Entra registration

config.snippet: In agent Tools, add Model Context Protocol with URL https://YOUR-SERVER/mcp; choose API key header Authorization, or OAuth 2.0 Dynamic discovery when server metadata supports it.

quirks: SSE transport is no longer supported after August 2025.
Callback URI is generated per configured connector and must be copied from the UI.

clients.name: Cursor
quirks: Register both web and desktop redirect URIs if both surfaces are used; DCR desktop can hand off to web callback.

clients.name: Windsurf
quirks: Official MCP configuration URL and exact remote config fields require confirmation against current Windsurf docs; callback URI not verified.

clients.name: JetBrains AI Assistant
quirks: Official example documents URL-only remote config; bearer header/OAuth support for this surface is not verified.

clients.name: Gemini CLI
quirks: Exact MCP config transport fields and callback behavior not verified from official docs.

clients.name: Zed

config.snippet: Zed MCP settings: add server URL https://YOUR-SERVER/mcp and Authorization: Bearer YOUR_POLARION_PAT

quirks: When no Authorization header is configured, Zed prompts for standard MCP OAuth; exact callback URI is not specified in cited docs.

clients.name: Cline

config.snippet: Cline MCP settings: configure a remote server at https://YOUR-SERVER/mcp with Authorization: Bearer YOUR_POLARION_PAT

quirks: Remote transport fields and OAuth callback behavior not verified against official Cline docs.
